finding: The supplied flat test folder contains 136 images that overlap with supplied training and/or validation images.
risk: Invalid final evaluation due to test leakage.
action_or_limitation: Use the rebuilt clean test split only.

finding: Exact duplicate hashes cross the supplied splits.
risk: Validation and test metrics may be inflated.
decision: Keep each unique image hash in exactly one derived split.
action_or_limitation: Run the zero-overlap verification before modeling.

finding: The unique labeled pool has fewer Normal than Pothole images.
risk: Accuracy may hide poor Normal-class performance.
decision: Preserve class ratios and use macro F1 with class-level precision and recall.
action_or_limitation: Any augmentation or class weighting will be applied only during training.

finding: HRP4K train.json lists 4203 images but the official downloaded archive contains only 2286 train JPG files.
risk: Training data and annotations cannot be matched; any V2 training would discard 1917 annotated records or introduce unsupported assumptions.
decision: Do not train or create a derived split from the current archive.
action_or_limitation: Obtain a corrected or supplementary provider archive and rerun the audit.

finding: Rome road-damage source has five exact duplicate image-hash groups.
risk: Duplicate images could leak across validation or protected test splits.
decision: Keep only one canonical copy from each exact-hash group before splitting.
action_or_limitation: Verify zero exact-hash overlap across the derived splits.

finding: Rome road-damage source has no provider train-validation-test split and no explicit video identifiers.
risk: Near-duplicate video frames may leak across a random image-level split.
decision: Use conservative filename capture-date groups for the derived split.
action_or_limitation: Document that full video-level independence cannot be proven.

finding: Rome road-damage COCO file has one zero-height crack box and 45 boxes extending outside image boundaries.
risk: Bounding-box quality is imperfect; object-detection use would require cleaning.
decision: Use only image-level pothole-presence labels for this capstone experiment.
action_or_limitation: Retain raw annotations and document this limitation.

finding: Rome road-damage source has no dedicated labels for shadows or newly repaired road surfaces.
risk: The model cannot be claimed to distinguish those confusing cases solely from this training data.
decision: Create a separately sourced and labeled external challenge set after the clean split is locked.
action_or_limitation: Do not report its results as protected-test metrics.
